Our client in the Netherlands, distributor in equipment, consumables and reagents for life sciences industry and universities, we are looking for a Sales manager (Brussels/Wallonia/ Luxemburg region) for a permanent position.
 

Verantwoordelijkheden
 
 

• After training of the products and equipment, you will be further guided by an experienced manager in the field to introduce the products to new and existing customers in the life science market. 

• You visit new customers and maintain contacts with existing customers.You listen to their needs, give advice and negotiate price proposals 

• You supervise and follow up demos of equipment / kits with customers in collaboration with the specialists. 

• You visit fairs, participate in seminars or webinars. 

• You meet your colleagues (1 day per month) at the office for team meetings, new product launches, administrative tasks, team building, etc 

• You report to the sales and marketing manager 

Vereisten
 
 

• You have a bachelor or master degree in biochemistry, biotechnology or you have relevant experience in a similar sales position. 

• You have a commercial attitude and you are communicative. 

• You have affinity with biotechnology lab equipment, consumables, reagents. 

• You can organize yourself, you are creative and can take initiative. 

• You speak and write fluently French and English and have a good knowledge of Dutch (is a plus).

Main Responsibilities

Editorial Duties

• Monitor and select relevant stories for daily digital coverage, prioritizing according to editorial value and available resources.
• React promptly to breaking news, ensuring accurate and timely publication.
• Produce clear, engaging, and factual content that aligns with Euronews' editorial standards.
• Coordinate with editors and other newsroom staff to ensure coherent and comprehensive coverage.
• Apply sound editorial judgment and perform fact-checking to ensure accuracy and balance.
• Analyze current events and contribute to editorial planning with informed insights.
• Edit and proofread articles written by other Euronews journalists.
• Curate and update the Euronews digital front page, maintaining a balanced and relevant news selection.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of editorial processes and workflows.
Technical and Organizational Duties

• Use newsroom production systems and digital publishing tools efficiently.
• Ensure the proper integration of multimedia elements in digital content.
• Collaborate with technical and editorial teams to resolve production issues when necessary.
• Maintain awareness of digital journalism trends and tools relevant to the role. 
Skills and Qualifications

Education and Experience

• Master education degree (minimum 4-5 years) in journalism or a related field from a recognised University
• Minimum of two (2) years' professional experience in journalism, including experience with breaking and hard news.
• Prior experience in an international or fast-paced newsroom environment is highly desirable.
• Excellent command of English (C2) and French (C2); knowledge of other Euronews languages is an asset.
• Strong understanding of European and international current affairs.
• Good knowledge of digital content production methods and audience consumption trends.
Technical Skills

• Proficiency in newsroom production systems and digital content management tools.
• Strong fact-checking and editing abilities.
• Analytical skills and problem-solving capabilities relevant to editorial production.
• Familiarity with live reporting and broadcast procedures is an advantage.
Interpersonal Skills

• Ability to work effectively in a team and within an editorial hierarchy.
• Capacity to perform under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commitment to Euronews' editorial values and journalistic standards of accuracy, impartiality, and fairness.

For a leading player in the Belgian logistics sector, we are looking for a CE Driver for the Ghent site.

For the Ghent site, we are looking for a CE Driver who enjoys working with a dedicated tractor unit and a flexible day schedule.

Your responsibilities

• Prepare each trip carefully and perform the necessary vehicle checks

• Verify transport documents and ensure load safety

• Couple and uncouple trailers

• Occasionally assist with loading and unloading goods

• Report any issues or delays to the planning team in a timely manner

• Carry out safe and efficient deliveries to customers and the airport

• Contribute to a professional and reliable service

Who are you?

• You hold a valid CE driving licence

• You have previous experience as a CE Driver

• You possess a valid digital driver card, ADR certificate, Code 95, and medical certificate

• You are willing to work a flexible schedule, starting from 5:00 AM

• You are prepared to spend 1 to 2 nights per week in the truck when required

• You are comfortable using GPS systems and other driving support tools

• You communicate effectively in Dutch, French or English

• You are customer-oriented, reliable, and responsible

• Safety and quality are always your top priorities

• You have a genuine passion for transport and logistics

Job description 
 What will you do? 
    
• 
        
Play the early bird: The road is yours while the rest of the world is still hitting snooze.

    
    
• 
        
Embrace variety: Shuttle between regional clients carrying agricultural products, sand, gravel, or waste (no ADR stress!).

    
    
• 
        
Be versatile: Switch smoothly between a tipper and a curtain-sider like it's nothing.

    
    
• 
        
Build some muscle: A physical challenge doesn't scare you off.

    

 Requirements 
 Who are you? 
    
• 
        
You hold a CE License + Code 95 (crucial, otherwise things get awkward with the police).

    
    
• 
        
You speak Dutch, French, or English (as long as we can understand each other by the coffee machine).

    
    
• 
        
You are flexible, precise, and treat your truck as if it were your own.

    
    
• 
        
Want extra hours? Great! More hours = more cash.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

Job description 

As our new Distribution Driver, you will deliver goods on euro-pallets to clients within your region. No heavy lifting required—you’ll be using an electric pallet jack!

    
• 
        
Hours: Full-time, averaging 10 hours per day.

    
    
• 
        
Schedule: Monday to Friday (weekends off).

    
    
• 
        
Stops: 15 to 25 customer deliveries per day.

    
    
• 
        
Start time: 07:00 AM.

    
    
• 
        
Region: Mainly West Flanders, with occasional trips to East Flanders and Wallonia.

    

 

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid Category C driving license.

    
    
• 
        
Based near Gullegem.

    
    
• 
        
Experience in distribution is a major plus.

    
    
• 
        
Flexible enough to occasionally drive a delivery van.

    
    
• 
        
Independent, proactive, safety-conscious, and customer-friendly.

    
    
• 
        
Fluent in Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.

What will you do?
 
 
 
• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system. 
 
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items. 
 
• Rotating tasks, including working in cold storage areas. 
 
• Registering goods correctly in the system. 
 
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment. 
 
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn. 
 
• You are flexible and willing to rotate in all shifts (early, late, and night). 
 
• You can handle working in cold areas. 
 
• You speak and understand English well. 
 
• You have your own means of transportation.

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do we expect?

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English. You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents. You have some experience driving a mega trailer. Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You possess a CE driving license and all necessary documents (Code 95, driver card).
    
• You have experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
    
• You enjoy working with different types of trailers and various goods. No day is the same!
    
• Physically demanding work does not deter you, and you carry out your tasks with a smile.
    
• You have your own transportation to get to the site.

Job description 

For our client, a renowned logistics company, we are looking for a motivated and experienced C Driver for the distribution center in Merelbeke. As a C Driver, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently transporting goods to various locations in East and West Flanders.

Tasks and responsibilities:

    
• Loading and unloading goods (various, food (including alcohol) and non-food) on pallets using an electric pallet truck.
    
• Safely and timely delivering goods to customers in East and West Flanders.
    
• Correctly filling out freight documents and maintaining administration.
    
• Maintaining and keeping the truck clean.
    
• Adhering to traffic rules and safety regulations.
    
• Providing customer-friendly service.

 Requirements 

    
• In possession of a valid driver's license C and code 95. Experience as a C Chauffeur, preferably in distribution.
    
• Good knowledge of the roads in East and West Flanders.
    
• Physically fit and able to load and unload independently.
    
• Customer-oriented, flexible, and reliable.
    
• Able to work independently.
    
• You speak good Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 
 What will you do?

As a CE Driver (ADR), you will perform irregular international routes throughout Europe. You will operate in a high-stakes environment where safety, precision, and strict adherence to procedures are the top priorities.

    
• 
        
Commute with ease: Depart from home in a company car heading towards Fleurus.

    
    
• 
        
Specialized Cargo: Transport radioactive and nuclear materials.

    
    
• 
        
Versatile Fleet: Operate both open and closed trailers equipped for ADR Tank and ADR Class 7.

    
    
• 
        
International Scope: Varied, non-fixed international routes.

    
    
• 
        
Teamwork: Work in double-crew shifts.

    
    
• 
        
Client Relations: Direct interaction with customers during delivery, following rigorous security protocols.

    
    
• 
        
Regulatory Contact: Regular interaction with authorities and inspection services.

    
    
• 
        
Hands-on Work: Responsible for loading and unloading, including securing cargo (strapping).

    
    
• 
        
Administration: Accurate management of transport documents and safety checklists.

    
    
• 
        
Flexibility: A five-day work week with variable hours; weekend work may be required based on planning.

    

 Requirements 
 What are we looking for?

We are seeking an experienced driver who treats responsibility and discretion with the utmost seriousness.

    
• 
        
Qualifications: Valid License CE with proven experience in international transport.

    
    
• 
        
Certifications: ADR Tank and ADR Class 7 (or a willingness to obtain these through our training program).

    
    
• 
        
Compliance: Medically fit and all mandatory documentation in order.

    
    
• 
        
Languages: Good proficiency in Dutch, French, and English. (Knowledge of German is a strong asset).

    
    
• 
        
Soft Skills: Independent, meticulous, and resilient under pressure.

    
    
• 
        
Professionalism: A professional attitude toward clients and official authorities.

    
    
• 
        
Mindset: A team player who can also excel when working independently.

Job description 

Our client in the Kortrijk/Menen region is looking for CE drivers for transporting sea containers. Usually for picking up and dropping off, but sometimes also just unloading at the quay. Nice working days of approximately 12 hours and home every day.

Loading and unloading locations at terminals in the ports of Ghent/Antwerp and at the client's warehouses and companies.

 Requirements 

You are motivated to work in the ports. You have a valid CE driving license with C95.

You have a good knowledge of Dutch, English, or French.

You live in the Kortrijk/Westhoek region.

Job description 

The Adventures of an International Driver
 Are you ready to take the wheel and turn every trip into an adventure? As an international driver, you’ll be transporting goods all across Europe—think the Netherlands, Germany, Luxembourg, and France—behind the wheel of a sleek tarpaulin truck.

From candy to concrete, meat to zinc on pallets, no two loads are ever the same. It’s like a market of surprises—just with more driving and fewer small talk breaks!

Planning and timing are your superpowers. You’ll keep trips efficient, respect driving and rest rules, and make sure every delivery reaches its destination perfectly. Customers? Think of them as friends—you’ll want to impress every single one.

Flexibility and independence are key. Unexpected challenges? You handle them like a pro. One thing’s for sure: life as an international driver is never boring, always full of variety, and packed with adventure.

 Requirements 

Driving License CE + Code 95 Reliable, Flexible

I can communicate in Dutch, French, and English. That's convenient, right? No language barriers here, just a glass wall full of fun!

Job description 

Love driving? We’re looking for a CE truck driver for day trips transporting pallets—full or empty, you’ll handle them all!

    
• 
        
Early start: 4–6 a.m.

    
    
• 
        
Average driving: 10–13 hours/day

    
    
• 
        
2–5 stops daily – build great client relationships

    
    
• 
        
No loading/unloading – technical support provided

    
    
• 
        
Work area: Belgium, S. Netherlands, W. Germany & N. France

    
    
• 
        
Shadow an experienced driver on your first day for a smooth start

    

Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we provide the guidance you need.

Apply now and join our team!

 Requirements 

Your profile To be successful in this role, you meet the following requirements:

    
• Papers: You possess a valid CE driving license and up-to-date Code 95.
    
• Language skills: You can express yourself fluently in Dutch, French, and English. This is essential for communication during international stops.
    
• Reliability: You are punctual, keep appointments, and handle equipment with care.
    
• Technical skills: Do you already have experience with the Transics black box? Then you have an advantage!
    
• Attitude: You are an early bird who can work independently.

jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.
